S.FORM: alang Paljur ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Maka go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 50 buwan, 148 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 95% kyan ku 141 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 5% kyan ku 7 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 86%, Bunun 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkyahu' na Paljur hya' ga Makazayazaya. tay 'zil na Paljur hya' ga Wakaba. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ paljur ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu maka ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** βunun * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkjaħuʔ na paljur ħjaʔ ɣa makazajazaja taj ʔzil na paljur ħjaʔ ɣa wakaβa reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
